After the values are restored, put both parts of B02 into the single blank in passport order. Format B04 and B14 as day/month/year. Arrange B05 as city, state or province, and country, adding any missing component by hand. If the B27 telephone is your mobile, put it in the Mobile No. blank and add a separate telephone number if you have one. List any additional current residential addresses in B26.

For B10, supply your government-issued ID number if applicable. For B11, check whether your passport is Diplomatic, Official, Ordinary, or Other, and for B13, enter its place of issue. Confirm whether B03, B09, B17, B33, B34, and B35 apply to you. If your inviter and guarantor are the same person, the form directs you to write “same as above” in B34.

Complete B36–B41 yourself and provide details in B42 for any Yes answer. Add the application date in day/month/year format and sign B44 by hand.
